title: What pre-vote is for
request:
An isolated node campaigns, first with pre-vote and then without

./your_program.sh raft-reads
init 3
partition 2
campaign 2
state
prevote off
campaign 2
state
note: Node 2 loses either way — it cannot reach a majority. The difference is what it costs everyone else: without pre-vote it comes back from the partition with a higher term and forces a working leader to step down, which is a re-election caused entirely by a node that was never eligible.

title: A linearizable read without writing anything
request:
An entry is committed, then read before and after the state machine applies it

./your_program.sh raft-reads
init 3
append
read-index
apply
read-index
note: Nothing was written to the log to serve this read. The cost is one heartbeat round and the patience to wait for apply — which is why ReadIndex is how a production Raft serves reads, rather than appending a no-op entry per read.
